QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] A Wish Upon A Falling Star
QuestInfo.0: #p2081004# says the light was a falling star. Continue listening for the details. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081004# felt the world get brighter when she was practicing her instruments. When she looked, up she saw a large falling star. Tell #p2081000#. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You told #p2081000# that #p2081004# saw the light. However, #p2081000# seemed more concerned about why #p2081004# was out and about at night. \r\n

yes.0: What?! #p2081004# saw the light? She must've been up late again, practicing her instruments. I keep warning her she'll get eaten by a dragon if she does that...

default.0: But don't tell the chief I saw it. Okay? Please?
